title: mime commit causes memory errors
body:
The commit b557182 introduced a memory error in the MIME API code.

Reproducible with this code, which is s stripped down lib1553.c but you can also just run the lib1553 test build makes:
```

#include "test.h"

#include "testutil.h"
#include "warnless.h"
#include "memdebug.h"

#define TEST_HANG_TIMEOUT 60 * 1000

int test(char *URL)
{
  CURL *curls = NULL;
  CURLM *multi = NULL;
  int still_running;
  int i = 0;
  int res = 0;
  curl_mimepart *field = NULL;
  curl_mime *mime = NULL;
  int counter = 1;

  start_test_timing();

  global_init(CURL_GLOBAL_ALL);

  multi_init(multi);

  easy_init(curls);

  mime = curl_mime_init(curls);
  field = curl_mime_addpart(mime);
  curl_mime_name(field, "name");
  curl_mime_data(field, "value", CURL_ZERO_TERMINATED);

  easy_setopt(curls, CURLOPT_URL, URL);
  easy_setopt(curls, CURLOPT_HEADER, 1L);
  easy_setopt(curls, CURLOPT_VERBOSE, 1L);
  easy_setopt(curls, CURLOPT_MIMEPOST, mime);
  easy_setopt(curls, CURLOPT_USERPWD, "u:s");

  multi_add_handle(multi, curls);

test_cleanup:

  curl_multi_remove_handle(multi, curls);
  curl_mime_free(mime);
  curl_multi_cleanup(multi);
  curl_easy_cleanup(curls);
  curl_global_cleanup();

  if(res)
    i = res;

  return i; /* return the final return code */
}

```
